facts.name: J. Ryan Love
facts.assignment: Walton Division A; Administrative Judge. Guide contains criminal and civil/family procedures; no exclusive assignment inferred.

contact.contact_note: Published judicial-office phone/fax and assistant email; no separate assistant-only line or judge personal email established.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number/name and relevant matter; copy all parties unless authorized otherwise. Substantive requests belong in filed documents.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion, then email assistant with motion, case/party details and requested hearing time. Obtain confirmation, immediately file/serve notice, and notify assistant of cancellations.

remote_appearances.summary: Civil/family hearings up to1hour may use Zoom by agreement; otherwise in person unless court authorizes remote appearance. Source also requires written motion/proposed order5days beforehand. Zoom link follows hearing confirmation; preserve both statements.

proposed_orders.summary: Word through proposed-order portal, with cover letter stating agreement/disagreement and actual service names/emails; generally5businessdays after proceeding unless directed otherwise.

courtesy_copies.summary: PDF by email to assistant, copying parties. Source says “Within five (5) days of hearing date”; preserve wording without inferring before/after.
